== Designed by (2026-10-26) ==
Added Designed by [[Scott Lingrell]], citing the 29 October 2002 swccgpc.com news (Wayback 6 November 2002). Andrew Howard wrote that Lingrell would be running a special playtest tournament for a possible new format, Classic Format, at DecipherCon 2002 Friday 7pm. The news does not use the word designed. Designed by follows the 25 October 2026 naming lock.

=== Missing data ===
* Early Phoenix Classic event (8 players, 5 RST Light decks; BlackViper, 2 March 2003): marginal, handle-only source
* Desperate Tactics Episode I icon misprint (Dec 2004): the post is a player's guess and names Desperate Tactics, while the 2015 guide names Desperate Times
* Statman (Oct 2003): every Dark deck in his area ran Mobilization Points: marginal local opinion
* Chris Wodicka's hearsay that Brangus and Deadbolt decks dominated the DecipherCon playtest: hearsay
* March 2003 posts saying Classic had 'no D-shields' and that EPPs were banned (Wayne Cullen, Sithborg): opinion, superseded by the May 2003 Starting Effects
* October 2003 metagame posts (PhataLerror, Sithborg): opinion
* Testing-phase bans of permanent-weapon characters and Brangus/Ketwol later lifted (Sithborg Jan 2003, Cam Solusar Sept 2003): the posts do not say when or by whom; left out
* JasonRed3 (March 2003): virtual EPP replacements were an option being considered; poster's identity and role not established
=== Possibly faulty data and open points ===
* Forum dates the playtest announcement 30 October 2002 (post time 2:07 am); the website news already on the page says 29 October 2002
* The December 2002 contest announcement set 7 February 2003 for naming winners; the January 2003 update on the page says reports were due 7 February and results 15 February
* Hunter (March 2004) is written as a handle; may be Brian Hunter but the posts do not say so
